mapper.select: SELECT * FROM acc_satisfaction_collection_task WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND task_revision_no = 1 AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE acc_satisfaction_collection_task SET assigned_to_user_id = #{query.assignedToUserId}, assigned_by_user_id = #{query.assignedByUserId}, version = version + 1, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.taskId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND task_status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT','PENDING_COLLECTION') AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM acc_satisfaction_collection_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.* FROM acc_satisfaction_collection_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND t.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND t.deleted = b'0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acc_satisfaction_collection_task newer WHERE newer.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND newer.collection_key = t.collection_key AND newer.task_revision_no > t.task_revision_no AND newer.deleted = b'0') AND t.id > #{query.afterId} ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{query.limit}
